title: Egg and mushroom donburi
summary: Egg and mushroom donburi is a japanese dinner built around medium eggs and chestnut mushrooms, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

ingredients.prepNote: beaten if the method says so

steps.instruction: Warm the oil and soften the onion for Egg and mushroom donburi. Stir in the garlic, ginger and spices until they smell fragrant.
steps.tip: If the spices look dusty, give them a minute in the oil before any liquid goes in.

steps.instruction: Add medium eggs and cook until it loses its raw look. Pour in the tomatoes or coconut and chestnut mushrooms.
Simmer gently, lid ajar, until basmati rice is tender and the sauce coats a spoon. Add a splash of water if it sticks.
steps.tip: Taste Egg and mushroom donburi before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Taste for salt and acid, then rest the pan for a couple of minutes before serving Egg and mushroom donburi.  Serve with the rice, simmered in salted water until tender.
